_comment: llama-mon config. Live installs keep theirs at /etc/llama-mon/config.json (installed by local/systemd/install.sh or seeded by the OpenRC installer); this file is the repo-side template. Precedence: defaults < this file < MON_* env. Unknown keys are ignored, so _comment strings are safe.
_gpus_comment: Visible GPU cards; [] = all. Identifiers: NVIDIA UUID (full or substring), nvidia index, amd:cardN, amd:BDF or BDF. This box: only the two V100s (the GTX 1080 stays hidden).
_throttle_comment: Above threshold -> each device gets its minimum power limit; at/below -> restore_watts (number or "default" = driver factory default). low_watts omitted = driver minimum (150 W on these V100s). Writes need root: run the service as root or install local/systemd/llama-mon.sudoers.
